about_comments:
Talaryn is a graphical Linux interface for mounting cloud and remote storage as local drives using rclone.

Installed rclone version: {version}
about_russian_translation_credit: Elvira Krakowska — edited the Russian translation
about_support_heading: Using the application? Help me develop it
about_support_body: Creating updates, fixing bugs, and adapting the application to new systems takes time. Voluntary support helps keep the project alive and lets it continue to grow.
sponsor_reminder_title: Using Talaryn? Help me develop it
sponsor_reminder_never: Do not show this window again
no_profiles: No profiles yet. Open the rclone connection manager and add a profile next to the selected drive.
no_visible_profiles: All profiles are hidden. Enable “Show hidden profiles” in Settings to display them.
no_remotes: No rclone remotes configured. Run: rclone config
remote_config_empty: No configured drives — use the + button
remote_config_connection_help: Choose a service and give the connection a unique name. It will be selected automatically in the profile after creation.
remote_config_choose_provider_help: Choose a storage type, then select a service or connection protocol.
remote_config_name_help: Give the connection a unique short name used by rclone.
remote_oauth_help: After the connection is created, rclone will open a browser so you can sign in securely.
remote_box_help: User accounts are connected through OAuth. Enterprise accounts can use a Box application configuration file.
remote_proton_help: Connect Proton Drive with your account credentials. Enter a 2FA code or OTP secret only when required.
remote_mega_help: Connect a MEGA account using its email address, password, and optional 2FA code.
remote_icloud_help: Connect iCloud Drive or iCloud Photos. Rclone may ask for an additional Apple sign-in confirmation.
remote_seafile_help: Connect a Seafile server using a password or an existing authentication token.
remote_seafile_2fa_help: Rclone will request the code while creating the connection.
remote_webdav_help: Connect Nextcloud, ownCloud, Fastmail, SharePoint, or any WebDAV server.
remote_smb_help: Connect a Windows, Samba, NAS, or other SMB/CIFS network share.
remote_smb_kerberos_help: Use the system Kerberos configuration and an existing credentials cache.
remote_b2_help: Use an Application Key ID and Application Key created in the Backblaze B2 console.
remote_b2_hard_delete_help: When disabled, deleted files remain as hidden older versions in B2.
remote_s3_help: Connect AWS S3 or compatible object storage. Choose a bucket later as the profile's remote path.
remote_s3_env_auth_help: Use environment variables, an AWS profile, or a role assigned to this computer.
remote_google_cloud_help: Connect Google Cloud Storage with OAuth, a service account, environment credentials, or anonymous access.
remote_azure_help: Choose the authentication method used by the Microsoft Azure Storage account.
remote_sftp_help: Connect over SSH using an agent, private key, or password.
remote_sftp_ssh_command: SSH command, for example ssh host-name
remote_sftp_verify_host_help: Verify the server identity using a known_hosts file.
remote_ftp_help: Use encrypted FTPS when the server supports it. Plain FTP sends data without encryption.
remote_ftp_verify_certificate_help: Disabling verification makes server impersonation easier.
remote_ftp_plain_warning_title: The connection will not be encrypted
remote_ftp_plain_warning_body: Plain FTP may send the username, password, and files as clear text. Continue only if the server does not support FTPS.
remote_config_please_wait: This may take a few seconds.
remote_oauth_wait: A web browser may open shortly.
remote_oauth_browser_wait: Finish signing in in your browser. This window will continue automatically after authorization.
remote_test_failed: The connection could not be confirmed
remote_config_failed: The connection could not be created
remote_config_unknown_error: Rclone did not provide error details.
remote_remove_failed: The incomplete connection could not be removed.
remote_name_invalid: The connection name cannot begin with a dash or contain :, /, or \.
remote_provider_unsupported: The selected connection type is not supported by this wizard.
remote_user_required: Enter a username or email address.
remote_seafile_auth_required: Enter a Seafile password or authentication token.
remote_service_account_required: Choose a service account JSON file.
remote_azure_account_required: Enter the Azure Storage account name.
remote_azure_key_required: Enter the Azure Storage account key.
remote_azure_connection_required: Enter the Azure Storage connection string.
remote_azure_principal_required: Enter the Tenant ID and Client ID for the service principal.
remote_box_config_required: Choose the Box application config.json file for an enterprise account.
remote_webdav_url_invalid: The WebDAV URL must begin with http:// or https://.
remote_webdav_insecure_auth: WebDAV credentials require HTTPS. Plain HTTP is allowed only for a local server.
remote_b2_credentials_required: Enter the Application Key ID and Application Key.
remote_b2_credentials_together: To change B2 credentials, enter both the Application Key ID and Application Key.
remote_s3_credentials_required: Enter the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key, or enable loading credentials from the environment.
remote_s3_credentials_together: To change S3 credentials, enter both the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key.
remote_known_hosts_required: Choose a known_hosts file or disable server host key verification.
remote_port_invalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
remote_manager_help: Manage rclone connections and the mount profiles created for them.
remote_manager_empty: There are no rclone connections yet. Use the + button to add the first one.
remote_manager_profile_edit_mounted: Unmount the profile before editing it.
remote_manager_edit_unsupported: This connection type does not have a graphical editor yet. It can still be removed or configured with rclone config.
remote_manager_read_failed: The connection configuration could not be read.
remote_delete_body: The “{name}” connection will be removed from the rclone configuration.
remote_delete_used_body: The “{name}” connection and all associated profiles will be deleted: {profiles}. Mounted profiles will be unmounted first. Local directories and cache will remain unchanged.
remote_delete_mounted: Unmount the profiles using this connection first: {profiles}.
remote_delete_failed: The rclone connection could not be deleted.
remote_profile_delete_body: The “{profile}” profile will be removed from the application. If mounted, it will be unmounted first. The rclone connection, local directory, and cache will remain unchanged.
remote_profile_unmount_failed: The profiles could not be safely unmounted: {profiles}. Neither the profiles nor the connection were deleted.
label: Label
cache_settings_help: Use − and + to choose a preset value, or enter any custom value supported by rclone.
duplicate_profile_target: This remote path and local mount directory are already used by profile: {profile}
mount_dir_in_use: This local mount directory is already used by profile: {profile}
installed_hint: Use install.sh to install the application for the current user.
preset_help: A ready-made set of options for a common workflow.
preset_balanced_help: Full read/write cache and a one-hour directory cache for general use.
preset_large_files_help: A full cache with a 50 GiB target limit retained for longer reuse; open files may temporarily exceed that limit.
preset_many_small_files_help: A long directory cache reduces expensive listings of large trees, but external changes may appear later.
preset_ssh_development_help: Fast write-back, symlink support, and a five-minute directory cache balance editor responsiveness with SFTP load.
preset_sftp_no_hashcheck_help: Prevents remote md5sum/sha1sum commands. Useful with external SSH or connection limits; comparisons rely on size and modification time.
preset_low_cache_help: Caches writes only and limits local storage use; repeated reads continue to come directly from the remote.
invalid_umask: Umask must contain 3 or 4 digits from 0 to 7, for example 022.
disk_usage_unavailable: Could not read disk usage information.
no_command_log: No command history has been recorded yet.
remote_path_empty: This directory does not contain subdirectories.
folder_icon_help: Choose an icon for the local mount directory.
unsupported_icon_file: Choose an SVG, PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WebP image file.
settings_appearance_help: Choose the interface language and its light or dark appearance.
settings_language_help: The language change is applied after the application is restarted.
settings_language_restart: Restart the application to apply the selected language.
settings_color_scheme_help: The theme is applied immediately after saving.
terminal_command_help: Command used to launch a terminal. Use the {ssh_command} placeholder, for example: gnome-terminal -- bash -lc {ssh_command}.
automount_previous_help: After login, start the panel icon and mount profiles remembered as mounted.
auto_remount_help: If a profile should stay mounted, the app will try to start it again.
disable_tray_icon_help: Do not start the status icon or quick mount menu.
minimize_to_tray_help: Closing the window hides it while the panel icon is enabled.
open_after_mount_help: Open the local drive folder after a manual mount. This does not apply to automatic mounting during system startup.
show_hidden_profiles_help: Display profiles previously hidden from a tile's context menu on the main page.
notify_transfer_complete_help: Show one system notification after a group of uploads finishes successfully.
notify_transfer_errors_help: Show a system notification when a file upload fails.
confirm_close_during_sync_help: Ask before quitting the application while a transfer is active or files are waiting in the queue.
inhibit_shutdown_during_sync: Prevent accidental system shutdown during synchronization
inhibit_shutdown_during_sync_help: Create a system shutdown inhibitor while a transfer is active or files are waiting in the queue. A forced shutdown will still be possible.
close_during_sync_body: Active transfers: {active}, queued: {queued}. Closing the interface will not stop the rclone services, but synchronization monitoring will no longer be visible. Quit the application anyway?
google_export_tip: Export a real copy. Normal copying copies only the browser link; moving it outside the mount sends the original to Google Drive Trash.
google_export_launch_failed: Could not start the Talaryn export tool.
google_export_warning: A *.link.html entry is a browser link, not an offline copy. Normal copying copies only the link and does not create a copy of the document. Moving it outside the mount moves only the link and sends the original Google document to Google Drive Trash. Export creates a real file and does not delete the original.
google_export_invalid_link: The selected file is not a recognized Google Docs, Sheets, or Slides link.
google_link_deleted_single: Removed “{name}”. If it was moved outside the mount, only the link was moved and the original document was sent to Google Drive Trash. You can restore it from there.
google_link_deleted_group: Removed {count} Google document links. If they were moved outside the mount, only the links were moved and the original documents were sent to Google Drive Trash. You can restore them from there.
clear_activity_history_help: Remove saved completed operations and errors. Current transfers and the queue remain unchanged.
clear_activity_history_confirmation: Saved completed operations and errors will be permanently removed. Current transfers and the queue will not be interrupted.
context_open_external_terminal_help: Show the SSH/SFTP action that opens the remote directory in a terminal.
context_copy_remote_path_help: Show the action that copies the rclone path for SSH/SFTP profiles.
context_google_new_docs_help: Show the actions for creating Google documents, sheets, and presentations.
context_file_comparison_help: Enable the comparison tool in the panel menu and Nautilus. This feature is in beta and is disabled by default.
comparison_compare_bytes_help: Read both files in every hash-matched pair again and compare their bytes directly.
comparison_hash_notice: Provider hashes are used when rclone can return them safely. While finding duplicates, SHA-256 is calculated locally only when a file has a potential same-size match and no common provider hash is available. For other files, SHA-256 can be calculated on demand with the button next to the hash. Remote files may then be downloaded in full. Optional byte-by-byte verification reads matching files again.
comparison_byte_calculating: Comparing {count} matching pairs byte by byte…
comparison_empty: There are no files to compare.
comparison_no_marked: No files or folders have been marked for comparison.
comparison_no_selected: No files or folders were selected for comparison.
comparison_marked_cleared: The marked selection has been cleared.
comparison_tag_identical_help: Hash, size, modification time and name match.
comparison_tag_modified_help: Modification times match within the precision supported by both locations.
comparison_tag_byte_help: The contents were additionally compared byte by byte.
comparison_folder_hash_help: Every paired file has matching {algorithm} content hashes.
comparison_folder_identical_help: Both folders contain the same relative file paths and matching contents.
comparison_folder_same_content_help: The folders contain the same data set, but file names or locations may differ.
comparison_tree_tag_identical_help: I — content, size, modification time, name, and relative path match.
comparison_tree_tag_hash_help: H — contents have a matching {algorithm} hash.
comparison_tree_tag_modified_help: M — modification times match within the supported precision.
comparison_tree_tag_byte_help: B — contents were additionally compared byte by byte.
logs_clear_failed: Could not clear all logs for profile: {profile}
sync_summary: Synchronization in progress — active transfers: {active}, queued: {queued}
upload_now_failed: Could not change this file's queue priority.
profile_monitor_unavailable: This drive's monitor is unavailable. Unmount and mount the profile again to enable the new monitoring API.
unmount_during_sync_body: This drive has {active} active transfers and {queued} queued files. Unmounting may interrupt transfers.
waiting_to_unmount: The drive will be unmounted automatically when its queue is empty.
settings_speed_limits_help: Enter a limit such as 10M or 512K. An empty field means unlimited. Changes are applied immediately to running drives.
invalid_speed_limit: Invalid limit. Use a number with an optional B, K, M, G, T, or P unit, for example 10M.
speed_limits_applied: The new speed limits have been applied.
speed_limits_apply_failed: Could not apply the limit to profiles: {profiles}
activity_hidden_patterns_help: One file or folder name pattern per line, matched at every level. Matching folders hide their entire contents. Use * for any text, ? for one character, or [abc] for a character set. Matching is case-sensitive; # is literal. Applies immediately to the activity list and its group totals, including history. Errors remain visible. Transfers and overall statistics are unaffected. Clear the list to show all files.
activity_show_hidden_help: Show activity for filenames matching the patterns in Settings.
unmount_safety_unknown: The synchronization status is unavailable or out of date. Safe unmounting cannot be confirmed. Wait for monitoring to recover, or explicitly unmount anyway; pending writes may be interrupted.
unmount_safety_blocked: Cannot safely unmount “{profile}”: transfers are pending or their status is unknown. Close files in this drive, wait for synchronization, and retry.
unmount_force_hint: Use --force only if you accept interrupting pending writes.
forget_mounted_blocked: Cannot forget “{profile}” while it is mounted or its service is running. Safely unmount it first.
comparison_disabled: File comparison is disabled. Enable “File and folder comparison (beta)” in Settings → Experimental features.
nautilus_compare_help: Add selected files or folders to the comparison pool and open Talaryn.
nautilus_unmark_help: Remove selected files from the Talaryn comparison pool.
nautilus_terminal_help: Open a terminal in the corresponding directory on the remote server.
nautilus_copy_path_help: Copy the rclone path for this item.
ssh_config_missing: No SFTP connection is configured in rclone.
ssh_exit_error: SSH failed (exit code {code}). Press Enter to close…
remote_path_copy_failed: Could not copy the remote path
clipboard_tool_missing: Install wl-copy, xclip, or xsel to copy paths.
google_new_help: Create a Google document in this folder.
google_file_id_missing: The file was created, but its Google Drive ID could not be retrieved.
xdg_open_missing: The xdg-open command is not installed.
google_file_create_failed: Could not create the Google file
google_file_exists: A file named “{title}” already exists. Choose a different name.
google_create_invalid_folder: Choose a folder inside a Google Drive mount.
google_refresh_failed: The document was created, but the folder could not be refreshed. Retry refreshing or check the document in Google Drive.
google_create_launch_failed: Could not start the Talaryn Google document dialog.
google_history_save_failed: The document was created, but its history entry could not be saved: {error}
google_creation_not_confirmed: No new document creation was confirmed. A document with this name may have been created concurrently. Check Google Drive before trying again.
